title: elm-kernel-patcher manifest
description: The Git commits that a patch archive is built from, one for each patched Elm package. The cli-elm-kernel-patcher archive commands read it.

$schema.description: The address of this schema, for editors.

patches.description: One entry for each package to patch. A package may appear only once; the archive commands check that.

packageName.description: The Elm package that the commit replaces, for example elm/core. The elm.json of the commit must declare the same name.

git.description: The Git address of the fork. Any server works, and a private repository works with your Git credentials.

commit.description: The full hash of the commit. A branch name or a short hash is refused, because it can point somewhere else later.

pullRequest.description: Free text for the reader, usually the address of the pull request that explains the change.
